categories.main_business_segments: Suzhou Nanowin Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in high-performance nanosphere materials research, large-scale production, sales, and application services. Its main application fields include biopharmaceutical processes, flat panel displays, analytical testing, and in vitro diagnostics. The company also provides chromatographic consumables, instruments, and purification technology services, with subsidiaries engaged in chromatography instruments and related technologies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has proprietary technologies in precise nanosphere preparation, including monodisperse porous silica and polymer microspheres, surface hydrophilization, functionalization, and large-scale production. It develops chromatographic fillers and media with controlled particle size, pore size, and surface chemistry. Key innovations include soft gel affinity chromatography media (NMab Titan), oligonucleotide solid-phase synthesis polymer carriers (NMOligo), and high-performance chromatographic columns. The company also integrates instrument development with consumables for comprehensive chromatographic solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in the biopharmaceutical industry, including innovative drug manufacturers, contract research and manufacturing organizations (CRO/CDMO), and pharmaceutical companies engaged in antibody, ADC, GLP-1, peptide, vaccine, and nucleic acid drug projects. Other markets served include analytical testing for life sciences, food safety, environmental monitoring, chemical industry, flat panel display manufacturers, and in vitro diagnostic reagent producers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Suzhou, Changshu, Nantong, and Zhejiang. It has subsidiaries and business operations in the United States, India, and Europe, actively expanding its international market presence through participation in global exhibitions and establishing overseas technical and marketing centers.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nanowin operates mainly in the upstream and midstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the research, development, and manufacturing of core nanosphere materials and chromatographic consumables. It also extends downstream by providing integrated purification systems, chromatographic instruments, and technical services, thus covering a broad spectrum from raw material production to end-user application support.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in high-performance nanosphere materials and chromatographic technologies, targeting key biopharmaceutical purification needs. It invests heavily in R&D (22.64% of revenue in 2024), focusing on product iteration, new affinity media, solid-phase synthesis carriers, chromatographic columns, and advanced instruments. Strategic priorities include expanding international markets, integrating acquisitions (e.g., Fuli Instruments), and developing system-level solutions combining materials, instruments, and services.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of chromatographic fillers, media, analytical instruments, and related consumables. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by distributors for instruments. It also earns income from technical services, project-based purification solutions, and licensing of proprietary technologies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Nanowin is a leading domestic player in China’s high-performance nanosphere and chromatographic consumables market, breaking the long-standing monopoly of multinational companies like Cytiva, Merck, Agilent, Waters, and Thermo Fisher. It holds a strong position in the domestic market with growing international presence, leveraging proprietary technologies and integrated product platforms to compete against global giants.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved RMB 782.46 million in revenue, a 33.33% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 82.84 million, up 20.82%. R&D investment reached RMB 177.17 million, accounting for 22.64% of revenue. The company has expanded through acquisitions, including a controlling stake in Fuli Instruments, and maintains steady growth with a diversified product portfolio and increasing overseas sales (up 122.19%).
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nanowin offers highly uniform, monodisperse nanosphere materials with precise control over particle size, pore size, and surface functionality, enabling superior chromatographic performance. Its products provide high mechanical strength, chemical stability, and reproducibility, supporting industrial-scale biopharmaceutical purification and analytical applications. The company differentiates itself through integrated solutions combining proprietary materials, advanced instruments, and comprehensive technical services, enabling domestic substitution of imported products and supporting customers’ process optimization and cost reduction.
